THE STORY

The world has fallen into a silent, monochromatic slumber. Glued to screens, humanity's collective doomscrolling feeds the hollow Hueless, draining all color and vitality from the land.

The world's survival now rests on Clio, a young chromatist student from RYB Academy. By channeling her emotions into her Prismal companion, Lochmoo, she grants him the color and power needed to defeat the Hueless.

Join her on her journey as she travels across the world to restore the color balance.

AN ATMOSPHERIC COLOR-RESTORATION JOURNEY

Prismals is a tightly focused, low-poly RPG game that blends emotional narrative with dynamic color mechanics. As Clio, you must navigate a world stripped of its vitality, using chromatic energy to push back the digital noise and reclaim the landscape piece by piece.

KEY FEATURES

  • Emotion-Driven Synergies: Channel Clio’s emotional frequencies directly into Lochmoo, unlocking distinct chromatic powers and combat abilities to defeat the Hueless.

  • Real-Time World Restoration: Watch as barren, hueless environments visually transform and burst back into vibrant life as you clear corruption and defeat area bosses.

  • Diverse & Hazardous Biomes: Journey across varied environments—from the neon-drenched streets of a digital metropolis to scorching volcanic pits, frozen arctic wastes, dense canopy jungles and sun-bleached deserts.

  • The Legacy of a Master: Uncover the mystery behind Lily, Clio’s mother and one of the greatest Chromatists the world has ever known. Walk in her footsteps and prove yourself worthy of the RYB Academy.

  • A Dedicated Micro-Indie Experience: Designed to be a roguelike that can be fully experienced in a single, focused sitting of 60 to 180 minutes.

  • Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in a full original OST.

GAMEPLAY & MECHANICS

In Prismals, players will balance exploration, environmental hazards and tactical combat.

  • Identify Frequencies: Different Hueless enemies and environmental obstacles respond to specific emotional color frequencies.

  • Command Lochmoo: Switch between color states to shield Clio, break through enemy armor and trigger chain reactions.

  • Purify the Land: Every cleared challenge brings permanent color back to the world, opening new paths and revealing hidden secrets.
